sufficiency_note: Development starting material only. Qualify each new asset component and its scope independently.
purpose: Official retained interface examples plus a labelled synthetic asset scenario. All implementation and measurement remain pending.
original_acceptance: The minimum implementation consumes valid named inputs and meets the reviewed behavior cases; examples/templates alone do not establish completion.
Every mandatory artifact exists or maps to agreed equivalent sections; preserve original evidence and disclose unresolved failures.

Publish the specified baseline/metric results with denominators, measured/not-run state and limitations. A negative result may satisfy research acceptance if the protocol and artifact requirements are met.
Activation, authorization and existing platform boundaries remain enforced; no new owner, command or queue authority is introduced.
Named supporting reviewers reproduce the relevant contract/case check and record findings/disposition.

asset_research_plan.decision: Start with the protocol and reviewed expectations, then run the core asset pipeline on frozen authorized exports and separately labelled synthetic edge cases. C17/C20/C21/C13 are not hard prerequisites for this core benchmark.
questions: Which independently reviewed asset facts and change sequences exercise false merges, missed changes, stale evidence and partial collection?
Does adaptive recollection resolve comparable evidence gaps with less collection cost than full refresh under identical safety limits?
Which claimed gain disappears when identity resolution, deltas, freshness or budget selection is removed?
Which smallest implementation answers the declared project need, and what evidence would make the extension unnecessary?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Freeze a complete-inventory/straight set-diff baseline and a sensible field-age rule baseline before final comparison. Use identical cases, scope and budgets; disclose when a comparator is unavailable.
cases: The adaptive candidate has not been qualified — Core evidence evaluation must not wait for every extension or a patch/recovery demonstration.
Labels were copied from the component under test — Independent source/export review is necessary to avoid circular evaluation.
Lower example cost but a critical quality error — A cheaper unsafe decision is not a demonstrated improvement. These are hypothetical numbers, not measured findings.
consumers: C23: core asset qualification evidence before the optional relationship experiment.
C16 reviewers: optional asset-specific contribution evidence without replacing the end-to-end demo.
Faculty/team scope review: measured supported-profile benefit, limitations and negative findings.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous independently checks case expectations and experiment design; Omar reproduces the asset pipeline/consumer contract.
asset_research_plan.start: Protocol, question and case design start now. Core measured acceptance requires delivered C03/C05/C18/C19 inputs. Optional identity/adaptive/campaign comparisons are follow-up slices only after their own activation gates.

implementation_reference.title: Build Independent Asset Cases & Evaluate Evidence Quality
implementation_reference.minimum: Start with the protocol and reviewed expectations, then run the core asset pipeline on frozen authorized exports and separately labelled synthetic edge cases. C17/C20/C21/C13 are not hard prerequisites for this core benchmark.
implementation_reference.gate: Protocol, question and case design start now. Core measured acceptance requires delivered C03/C05/C18/C19 inputs. Optional identity/adaptive/campaign comparisons are follow-up slices only after their own activation gates.
implementation_reference.interface: evaluate_asset_cases(case_manifest, expected_labels, method_revision, run_config) → per_case_results, metric_denominators, failures, limitations, measured_or_not_run_state. Expected labels must not come solely from the evaluated component.
implementation_reference.baseline: Freeze a complete-inventory/straight set-diff baseline and a sensible field-age rule baseline before final comparison. Use identical cases, scope and budgets; disclose when a comparator is unavailable.
metrics: False removals from partial collection, false-usable/fresh states, identity mismatches and unresolved cases per case family.
Paired cost/quality outcomes for optional C20 only after real field-level collection is qualified.
Separate real-lab, replay and synthetic denominators; record failures and small-sample uncertainty.
creative: Propose a useful hypothesis and an ablation that could falsify it; predeclare the baseline, cases and success/safety criteria.
A reproducible negative result or simpler winning baseline is an acceptable research outcome.

steps: Draft and review the protocol, expected-case annotation guide and comparison questions before implementing the candidate methods.
Freeze source/export revisions and independent expectations for complete, partial, stale, conflicting and failed cases.
Run the core C18/C19 comparisons as soon as their inputs are delivered; do not wait for C13 or optional extensions.
Recompute per-case errors and denominators from raw results, keeping all failures visible.
For optional studies, freeze added criteria before seeing the results; compare identical cases and count all collection overhead.
Publish evidence, limitations and positive/tied/negative conclusions. Mark unavailable comparisons not_run rather than assuming benefit.
implementation_reference.status: Planning reference and synthetic expected behavior; product implementation and lab results pending.
